name: drama-subtitle-proofreader
description: 短剧字幕校对专家：导入短剧视频，本地OCR或ASR识别字幕，与台词原文逐条比对标色，人工修正后导出SRT、烧录视频与校对报告

displayDescription.en: Import short drama video, recognize subtitles via local OCR or ASR, align with the script, highlight diffs, then export SRT, burned video and report.
displayDescription.zh: 导入短剧视频，本地OCR或ASR识别字幕，与原文逐条比对标色，修正后导出SRT与烧录视频。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一集短剧需要校对字幕，请导入视频识别字幕并与台词原文比对
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a short drama episode that needs subtitle proofreading. Please import the video, recognize subtitles, and align them with the script

quickPrompts.zh: 我有一集短剧需要校对字幕，请导入视频识别字幕并与台词原文比对
quickPrompts.en: I have a short drama episode that needs subtitle proofreading. Please import the video, recognize subtitles, and align them with the script

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这部短剧的字幕烧录进视频，导出带字幕的MP4
quickPrompts.en: Help me burn the corrected subtitles into the video and export an MP4 with subtitles

quickPrompts.zh: OCR识别不准，切换到音频ASR模式重新识别字幕
quickPrompts.en: OCR recognition is inaccurate, please switch to ASR audio mode to re-recognize the subtitles
